title: Lightly Simmered Tunisian Oats Tagine
description: A fresh and snappy Tunisian dish featuring rolled oats, this tagine is a nostalgic treat that is gluten-free-friendly and perfect for a comforting meal. It combines the simplicity of oats with the rich flavors of Tunisian spices.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the rolled oats and stir to coat the oats with the spice mixture.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and the mixture has a creamy consistency.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve the tagine in individual bowls and enjoy.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
